features.title: Onboarding Tutorial Prompt System
features.desired_outcome: Add introductory guidance pop-ups or text tooltips for new players starting their first route.
features.reason: First-time players need welcome tooltips at step 0 to understand initial movement and combat mechanics.

features.title: Route Discovery Ledger and Collection Milestones UI
features.desired_outcome: An in-game UI tab displaying collected route items and milestones.
features.reason: Explorers and collectors desire an in-game tracking interface for unique route items and completion rewards.

features.title: Route-Specific Secret Collectibles and Cosmetic Unlocks
features.desired_outcome: Introduce rare hidden pick-ups on existing routes that unlock themed accessories or vanity tints.
features.reason: Revisiting routes currently lacks specialized discovery mechanics once standard completion rewards are claimed.

features.title: Elite Enemy Encounters and Wave Compositions on Difficulty 3+ Routes
features.desired_outcome: Introduce denser enemy formations, aggressive behavior profiles, and hazard-synergized combat encounters specifically for Difficulty 3 and higher routes.
features.reason: Current high-difficulty routes like Frostfang Pass lack sufficient enemy density and mechanical friction, resulting in pacing that feels too passive.

features.title: Adjusted Marketplace Bundle Special for Mid-Tier Cosmetics
features.desired_outcome: Introduce a rotating weekend marketplace special or bundle discount to maintain purchasing momentum for active economy players.
features.reason: The coin delta between standard route completion rewards and high-end items like the Waypoint Crown leaves players stranded with low balances (21 coins remaining in trace), making a promotional discount or milestone coin bonus very effective for retention.

features.title: Keyboard Shortcut Prompts on Marketplace & HUD
features.desired_outcome: Add visible keyboard shortcut hints (e.g., [1] to buy, [Esc] to close) directly onto UI buttons and marketplace panels.
features.reason: Clear hotkey indicators reduce cognitive load and improve usability for accessibility-focused players.

features.title: Movement Command Input Buffering & Obstacle Feedback
features.desired_outcome: Add input validation so that walking into an active hazard triggers an immediate contextual hint or buffers the necessary jump command.
features.reason: Edge-case telemetry shows players frequently attempt to keep walking into barriers before realizing a jump is required.

features.title: Elite Enemy Behavior Profiles for Difficulty 3+ Routes
features.reason: Combat challengers reported low enemy encounter density and mechanical friction on high-tier routes.

features.title: High-Contrast UI Theme & Focus States
features.reason: Accessibility council noted that marketplace navigation and UI elements need clearer keyboard focus rings.

features.title: Movement Command Validation & Obstacle Input Buffering
features.reason: Edge-case telemetry shows redundant walk commands attempting to queue against active hazard collisions.

policy.note: AI beta-test recommendations are advisory. The owner manually implements changes with ChatGPT and uses Development Review only to monitor status.
